message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 73.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in parallel computing and Business process analyst. I want to become a Database Administrator. My family can afford at most about USD 800 per year. I live in Chennai. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
reflection_note: The current shortlist only contains PR0165, which is a solid choice. Since the candidate set is very small and PR0165 already addresses all major constraints (location, budget, background fit), no swaps are necessary or possible. The single program remains the best recommendation.
explanation:
Westbrook Institute of Technology
This program was recommended because it perfectly matches your location preference in Chennai and stays well within your maximum budget, with an annual tuition cost of $550 USD. Furthermore, your academic background meets the minimum grade requirement of 54% and satisfies the need for a CS background. While the degree focuses on Cloud Computing rather than Database Administration, this field is highly relevant to modern database infrastructure and offers good employability potential (median salary: $7,845 USD). The main trade-off you should consider is the post-study work visa duration, which is listed as 0 months, limiting immediate career mobility after graduation.
